chapter: 功名章第六十二(官职部分之三)

units.title: 补官起服、援例纳粟与图差代役、选缺参房：补官起服援例纳粟戒世空而反遁；图差代役选缺参房问成则冲不利谋、世不利空、官不利坏，问财不利财虚，问辱不利官克世

rule.yi: 补授官职、服满起复、依例捐纳的，要戒备世空，反而退缩不成。图差使、代役、选缺、参房，问成不成：冲不利图谋，世不利空，官不利坏；问财，就不利财虚；问受辱，就不利官克世。
rule.en: For being appointed to a vacant post, being recalled after mourning, or buying office by precedent, beware of the Self being Void, for one will on the contrary draw back. For seeking a commission, taking another's place in a duty, selecting a vacancy or entering the clerks' office, in asking whether it comes off: clash is unfavourable to the plan, Void is unfavourable to the Self, damage is unfavourable to Pressure; in asking about money, empty Wealth is unfavourable; in asking about disgrace, it is unfavourable for Pressure to control the Self.

zh: 补官起服、援例纳粟，戒世空而反遁也。
图差代役、选缺参房，问成乎，
冲不利谋也，世不利空也，官不利坏也，
问财则不利财虚，
问辱则不利官克世也。
yi: 补授官职、服满起复、依例捐纳的，要戒备世空，反而退缩不成。
图差使、代役、选缺、参房，问成不成：
冲不利图谋，世不利空，官不利坏；
问财，就不利财虚；
问受辱，就不利官克世。
en: For being appointed to a vacant post, being recalled after mourning, or buying office by precedent, beware of the Self being Void, for one will on the contrary draw back.
For seeking a commission, taking another's place in a duty, selecting a vacancy or entering the clerks' office, in asking whether it comes off:
clash is unfavourable to the plan, Void is unfavourable to the Self, damage is unfavourable to Pressure;
in asking about money, empty Wealth is unfavourable;
in asking about disgrace, it is unfavourable for Pressure to control the Self.

note.yi: 「补官」是补授官职（补缺），「起服」是守丧期满起用（起复），「援例纳粟」是依成例捐纳、出钱买官。「图差」是谋差使，「代役」是顶替差役，「选缺」是选官补缺，「参房」是吏员入衙门房科当差（这几样见易林补遗选缺参房 EL.76–78、谋差顶役 EL.106–108）。「反遁」的「遁」按文意是动词，退缩落空，不是遁卦。「问辱」是问会不会受辱，也就是受责罚。这一条把几种求职的小占问合在一起，断法都落在常见的几个忌上：冲、世空、官坏、财虚、官克世。
note.en: 'Bu guan' is being appointed to a post, filling a vacancy; 'qifu' is being recalled to office when the period of mourning is over; 'yuanli nasu' is buying office by contribution under a standing precedent. 'Tuchai' is seeking a commission, 'daiyi' is taking the place of a runner, 'xuanque' is selecting an official to fill a vacancy, and 'canfang' is a clerk entering a department of a yamen to serve (these are in the Yilin Buyi on selecting vacancies, EL.76-78, and on seeking commissions, EL.106-108). The 'dun' of 'fan dun' is by the sense a verb, drawing back and coming to nothing, and is not the hexagram Dun. 'Wen ru' is asking whether one will suffer disgrace, that is, reproof or penalty. This entry puts together several small divinations about seeking a post, and judges them by the familiar taboos: clash, a Void Self, damaged Pressure, empty Wealth, Pressure controlling the Self.

units.title: 久任与履任身安：筮久任三冲游魂则不久、官坏罢职、世空解组、官克世参谪；筮履任身安随墓助伤则及任乃病、世破鬼发则临政抱灾；久任以官为官、身安以官为病，妙在变

rule.yi: 占能不能久任：三冲、游魂就不长久；官坏就罢职；世空就解印离任；官克世就被参劾、贬谪。占到任后身体平安与否：随墓、助伤，就是一到任就生病；世破、鬼发，就是临政时抱灾祸。占久任，以官爻为官职本身；占身安，以官爻为病；占卜取用爻，妙处在于变通。
rule.en: In divining whether one will keep the post long: the three clashes or Wandering Soul mean it will not last; Pressure damaged means dismissal; the Self Void means laying down the seal and leaving the post; Pressure controlling the Self means impeachment and demotion. In divining whether one will be safe in body on taking up the post: following into the tomb and helping the injury means falling ill on arriving at the post; the Self broken and Pressure moving means bearing calamity while in charge of government. For a long tenure the Pressure line is taken as the office itself; for bodily safety it is taken as illness; in divining, the wonder of using a line lies in the change.

zh: 或筮久任乎，三冲游魂则不久，
官坏而罢职，
世空而解组，
官克世而参谪。
或筮履任身安乎，
随墓助伤，及任乃病，
世破鬼发，临政抱灾也。
yi: 占能不能久任：三冲、游魂就不长久；
官坏就罢职；
世空就解印离任；
官克世就被参劾、贬谪。
占到任后身体平安与否：
随墓、助伤，就是一到任就生病；
世破、鬼发，就是临政时抱灾祸。
en: In divining whether one will keep the post long: the three clashes or Wandering Soul mean it will not last;
Pressure damaged means dismissal;
the Self Void means laying down the seal and leaving the post;
Pressure controlling the Self means impeachment and demotion.
In divining whether one will be safe in body on taking up the post:
following into the tomb and helping the injury means falling ill on arriving at the post;
the Self broken and Pressure moving means bearing calamity while in charge of government.

zh: 久任以官为官，身安以官为病，
卜筮用爻，妙在变尔。
yi: 久任以官爻为官职本身，身安以官爻为病；
占卜取用爻，妙处在于变通。
en: For a long tenure the Pressure line is taken as the office itself, for bodily safety it is taken as illness;
in divining, the wonder of using a line lies in the change.

note.yi: 「久任」是长久任职，「履任」是到任，「身安」是到任后自身平安。「三冲」（见 YM.07 注）是冲散，「游魂」是迁动，都主不长久。「罢职」是革职，「解组」是解下印绶、卸任，「参谪」是被参劾、谪贬。「及任乃病」是一到任就生病。注里「久任以官为官，身安以官为病」：同一个官爻，占久任取它作官职（官坏就罢），占身安取它作病（鬼发就是病灾）；「妙在变尔」书里没有再展开，「变」字这里按文意读作变通，取什么要看所占的事。和黄金策仕宦的世动逢空（HJC.08）、卦静世空（HJC.16）、易隐官禄占在任（YY.14–YY.20）对着看。
note.en: 'Jiuren' is holding a post for a long time, 'lüren' is taking up the post, and 'shen an' is one's own safety after taking up the post. The 'three clashes' (see the note to YM.07) are clash and scatter and 'Wandering Soul' is shifting, both meaning it does not last. 'Bazhi' is dismissal, 'jiezu' is untying the seal-ribbon and leaving the post, and 'canzhe' is being impeached and demoted. 'Ji ren nai bing' is falling ill on arriving at the post. In the note 'for long tenure take Pressure as the office, for bodily safety take Pressure as illness': the same Pressure line is taken as the office when divining about tenure (damaged Pressure means dismissal), and as illness when divining about safety (Pressure issuing means a sickness); 'miao zai bian er' is not expanded in the book, and 'bian' is read here by the sense as adapting, what is taken depending on what is asked. Compare the Huangjin Ce on the Self moving into Void (HJC.08) and the still hexagram with a Void Self (HJC.16), and the Yi Yin on being in office (YY.14-YY.20).

units.title: 求荐奖与谪官开复：官文破坏恐荐贤不力、鬼象克世虑奖饰非真、世值空亡求荣不遂望擢难迁；谪官开复同此推；民间坊匾旌表冠带衣巾乡贤乡饮同类

rule.yi: 求荐举、嘉奖，而遇到官爻、文书破坏，恐怕荐贤的人不出力；鬼象克世，担心嘉奖不是真心实意；世遇空亡，求荣不成，盼升也难迁。被贬谪的官员请求开复（恢复官职），也同此推断。民间的牌坊匾额、旌表、冠带、衣巾、乡贤、乡饮等事，也属同类。
rule.en: In seeking recommendation or commendation, if Pressure and Resource (the document line) are broken and damaged, one fears that those who recommend the worthy do not exert themselves; if the Pressure image controls the Self, one fears the commendation is not genuine; if the Self meets Void, seeking honour does not succeed and hoping for promotion one cannot move. For a demoted official asking to be reinstated, judge in the same way. Memorial arches and tablets in the villages, commendation, caps and sashes, scholars' robes, the shrine of local worthies, and the village drinking ceremony are of the same kind.

zh: 求荐奖，而遇官文破坏，恐荐贤之不力，
鬼象克世，虑奖餙之非真。
世值空亡，求荣不遂，望擢难迁。
谪官开复，亦同此推。
yi: 求荐举、嘉奖，而遇到官爻、文书破坏，恐怕荐贤的人不出力；
鬼象克世，担心嘉奖不是真心实意；
世遇空亡，求荣不成，盼升也难迁。
被贬谪的官员请求开复，也同此推断。
en: In seeking recommendation or commendation, if Pressure and Resource (the document line) are broken and damaged, one fears that those who recommend the worthy do not exert themselves;
if the Pressure image controls the Self, one fears the commendation is not genuine;
if the Self meets Void, seeking honour does not succeed and hoping for promotion one cannot move.
For a demoted official asking to be reinstated, judge in the same way.

zh: 民间坊匾、旌表、冠带、衣巾、乡贤、乡饮等事同类。
yi: 民间的牌坊匾额、旌表、冠带、衣巾、乡贤、乡饮等事，也属同类。
en: Memorial arches and tablets in the villages, commendation, caps and sashes, scholars' robes, the shrine of local worthies, and the village drinking ceremony are of the same kind.

note.yi: 「荐奖」是被上司荐举、嘉奖；「官文」是官爻和文书（父母爻）；「奖餙」的「餙」是「饰」，奖饰就是褒奖的话；「开复」是被贬谪的官员请求恢复官职。「坊匾」是牌坊匾额，「旌表」是朝廷表彰，「冠带」是赐冠带的荣典，「衣巾」是生员的衣巾，「乡贤」是入乡贤祠，「乡饮」是乡饮酒礼里被推为宾介。这些民间荣典占法同荐奖。与易林补遗官员荐奖（EL.79–88）对着看：那一章有更细的断法。
note.en: 'Jianjiang' is being recommended and commended by a superior; 'guanwen' is the Pressure line and the document line (the Resource line); the 'shi' of 'jiangshi' is the variant for 'to adorn', so 'jiangshi' is words of praise; 'kaifu' is a demoted official asking to be restored to office. 'Fangbian' is memorial arches and tablets, 'jingbiao' is imperial commendation, 'guandai' is the honour of being granted cap and sash, 'yijin' is the robe and cap of a licentiate, 'xiangxian' is entering the shrine of local worthies, and 'xiangyin' is being named a guest of honour at the village drinking ceremony. These village honours are divined in the same way as recommendation. Read against the Yilin Buyi on recommendation of officials (EL.79-88), which has finer judgments.

units.title: 面圣上书、叩阍献策与条陈于将相：不可遇遁；见六冲则上下睽隔、受五克（五爻克世）则披君逆鳞、五位伤（五爻空破绝散）则忠言逆耳；条陈于将相喜官兴而忌克世

rule.yi: 面见皇上上书、叩阍陈情献策，不可遇到遁卦。见六冲，就上下隔阂；受五爻的克，就触犯君主的逆鳞；五位受伤，就忠言逆耳。如果是向将相逐条陈述意见，喜官旺而忌克世。
rule.en: In presenting a memorial to the sovereign in person, or knocking at the palace gate to offer a plan, the hexagram Dun must not be met. Meeting a six-clash, high and low are estranged; suffering the control of the fifth line, one touches the reversed scale on the sovereign's throat; the fifth place being injured, loyal words grate on the ear. If one is presenting views item by item to a general or chief minister, thriving Pressure is welcome and controlling the Self is feared.

zh: 面圣上书，叩阍献策，遁不可遇也。
见六冲而上下睽隔，受五克而披君逆鳞，五位伤而忠言逆耳。
若条陈于将相，喜官兴而忌克世也。
yi: 面见皇上上书、叩阍陈情献策，不可遇到遁卦。
见六冲，就上下隔阂；受五爻的克，就触犯君主的逆鳞；五位受伤，就忠言逆耳。
如果是向将相逐条陈述意见，喜官旺而忌克世。
en: In presenting a memorial to the sovereign in person, or knocking at the palace gate to offer a plan, the hexagram Dun must not be met.

Meeting a six-clash, high and low are estranged; suffering the control of the fifth line, one touches the reversed scale on the sovereign's throat; the fifth place being injured, loyal words grate on the ear.
If one is presenting views item by item to a general or chief minister, thriving Pressure is welcome and controlling the Self is feared.

zh: 五克谓五爻克世，
五位，谓五爻空破绝散也。
yi: 五克就是五爻克世，
五位受伤，就是五爻空、破、绝、散。
en: 'Five controls' means the fifth line controlling the Self,
and 'the fifth place injured' means the fifth line Void, broken, extinct or scattered.

note.yi: 「面圣上书」是当面向皇上呈递奏章，「叩阍」是到宫门叩击喊冤、陈情，「献策」是进献谋略，「条陈」是向将相逐条陈述意见。「遁不可遇」按文意是遁卦（天山遁，是退避的象）不可遇，与书里别处「得遁而不进」同类，是按卦名取义的忌。「睽隔」是隔阂。「逆鳞」是传说龙喉下倒生的鳞，触到它龙必怒，比喻触犯君主的忌讳。「忠言逆耳」是忠言不被听从。书里自注：五克是五爻克世，五位伤是五爻空、破、绝、散。和易林补遗朝天面旨（EL.91–93）、黄金策仕宦的奏陈谏诤（HJC.26）对着看。
note.en: 'Mian sheng shang shu' is presenting a memorial to the sovereign face to face, 'kouhun' is knocking at the palace gate to complain of a wrong or plead one's case, 'xiance' is offering a plan, and 'tiaochen' is presenting views item by item to a general or minister. 'Dun bu ke yu', by the sense, is that the hexagram Dun (Retreat, the image of withdrawing) must not be met, of a kind with 'getting Dun, no advance' elsewhere in the book, a taboo taken from the name of the hexagram. 'Kuige' is estrangement. 'Nilin' is the scale growing the wrong way beneath a dragon's throat, which makes the dragon furious when touched, a figure for offending the sovereign's taboos. 'Loyal words grate on the ear' is loyal words not being heeded. The book's own gloss: 'five controls' is the fifth line controlling the Self, and 'fifth place injured' is the fifth line Void, broken, extinct or scattered. Read against the Yilin Buyi on the audience at court (EL.91-93) and the Huangjin Ce on memorials and remonstrances (HJC.26).

units.title: 在任防参罚与离任虑后患：在任而防参罚则恶子动而好官兴、世空则离任；离任而虑后患则好子动而恶官兴、世空则无事

rule.yi: 在任上防被参劾、处罚的，厌子孙动而喜官旺，世空就是要离任；离任后担心留下后患的，喜子孙动而厌官旺，世空就没有事。
rule.en: For one in office guarding against impeachment and penalty, Output moving is hated and Pressure rising is welcome, and the Self Void means leaving the post; for one who has left office and fears trouble afterwards, Output moving is welcome and Pressure rising is hated, and the Self Void means no trouble.

zh: 夫在任而防参罚，恶子动而好官兴，世空则离任。
离任而虑后患，好子动而恶官兴，世空则无事。
yi: 在任上防被参劾、处罚的，厌子动而喜官旺，世空就是要离任；
离任后担心留下后患的，喜子动而厌官旺，世空就没有事。
en: For one in office guarding against impeachment and penalty, Output moving is hated and Pressure rising is welcome, and the Self Void means leaving the post;
for one who has left office and fears trouble afterwards, Output moving is welcome and Pressure rising is hated, and the Self Void means no trouble.

note.yi: 「参罚」是被上司参劾、处罚。「恶」是厌，「好」是喜：在任上怕被参，所以厌子孙动（子孙克官、伤官）而喜官旺；离任之后怕被追究后患，反过来喜子孙动（子孙克官，官不来追）而厌官旺。「世空则离任」「世空则无事」是同一个世空在两种处境下的不同结果：在任时世空就是要离开，离任后世空就是没有事。这一条是同一组爻神在『在任』和『离任』两个处境下取向相反的例子；黄金策仕宦的子孙交重（HJC.03）只讲了在任的一面。
note.en: 'Canfa' is being impeached and penalised by a superior. 'E' is dislike and 'hao' is liking: in office one fears impeachment, so Output moving (Output controls Pressure and injures the office) is hated and thriving Pressure welcome; after leaving office one fears being called to account for what is left behind, and the other way round Output moving (Output controls Pressure, so the office does not come after one) is welcome and thriving Pressure is hated. 'The Self Void means leaving the post' and 'the Self Void means no trouble' are different results of the same Void Self in two situations: while in office a Void Self means leaving, and after leaving it means nothing happens. This entry is an example of the same set of lines leaning opposite ways in the two situations of being in office and having left; the Huangjin Ce on Output moving (HJC.03) speaks only of the in-office side.

units.title: 大计与告养：大计求官鬼无瑕、世爻有气，官临日月生扶定膺卓异廉能之选、子孙动有降职之忧、兄弟摇有罚俸之议、兼逢官破致仕还乡；养亲告病休官若官克世被恶、官爻破绝空散、世随墓助伤则辞不得去

rule.yi: 问大计（定期考核官员），要官鬼没有瑕疵，要世爻有气；官临日、月又得生扶，必定被选在卓异、廉能的一等；子孙动，就有降职的忧虑；兄弟摇动，就有罚俸的议论；再遇官破，就致仕还乡。为奉养双亲请假、告病辞官：如果官克世而被厌恶，官爻破、绝、空、散，谁能明白你高蹈归隐的心怀；世象随墓、助伤，反而被世俗的尘缘束缚。
rule.en: In asking about the grand evaluation of officials, one wants Pressure without flaw and the Self line with force; if Pressure sits on the Day or Month and is generated and supported, one will surely be chosen among the outstanding, upright and capable; Output moving, there is the worry of demotion; Peer stirring, there is talk of a fine of salary; and if Pressure is also broken, one retires and goes home. In asking leave to support one's parents or retiring on grounds of illness: if Pressure controls the Self and one is disliked, and the Pressure line is broken, extinct, Void or scattered, who will understand a heart set on lofty retreat; if the Self image follows into the tomb and helps the injury, one is instead bound by the dust of the world.

zh: 大计之问，求官鬼之无瑕，索世爻之有气，
官临日月生扶，定膺卓意廉能之选，
子孙动而有降职之忧，
兄弟摇而有罚傣之议，
兼逢官破，致仕还乡。
养亲给假，告病休官，
若官克世而被恶，官爻破绝空散，谁明高蹈之怀，
世象随墓助伤，反受风尘之缚。
yi: 问大计，要官鬼没有瑕疵，要世爻有气；
官临日月又得生扶，必定被选在卓异、廉能的一等；
子孙动，就有降职的忧虑；
兄弟摇动，就有罚俸的议论；
再遇官破，就致仕还乡。
为奉养双亲请假、告病辞官：
如果官克世而被厌恶，官爻破、绝、空、散，谁能明白你高蹈归隐的心怀；
世象随墓、助伤，反而被世俗的尘缘束缚。
en: In asking about the grand evaluation, one wants Pressure without flaw and the Self line with force;
if Pressure sits on the Day or Month and is generated and supported, one will surely be chosen among the outstanding, upright and capable;
when Output moves, there is the worry of demotion;
when Peer stirs, there is talk of a fine of salary;
and if Pressure is also broken, one retires and goes home.
In asking leave to support one's parents or retiring on grounds of illness:
if Pressure controls the Self and one is disliked, and the Pressure line is broken, extinct, Void or scattered, who will understand a heart set on lofty retreat;
if the Self image follows into the tomb and helps the injury, one is instead bound by the dust of the world.

note.yi: 「大计」是明清对官员的定期考核（三年一次的外官大计，京官则是京察）。「卓意」疑是「卓异」之误：卓异是考绩最优，「廉能」是廉洁能干。「罚傣」的「傣」是「俸」之误，罚俸是扣俸禄。「致仕还乡」是退休回家。「养亲给假」是请假奉养双亲，「告病休官」是以病为由辞官。「高蹈」是远走高飞、归隐不仕，「高蹈之怀」就是想辞官归隐的心；「风尘之缚」是被世俗尘缘束缚，这里指走不脱。书里的断法：大计要官鬼无瑕、世爻有气，子孙动、兄弟摇都不利，官破则退休；辞官的占问反过来，官克世、官爻破绝空散、世随墓助伤，都是辞不掉。和易隐官禄占的官职退复（YY.28）、在任（YY.20）对着看。
note.en: 'Daji' is the periodic evaluation of officials under the Ming and Qing (the triennial evaluation of provincial officials, and for officials in the capital the capital review). 'Zhuoyi' written 'zhuoyi' with another character is presumably a slip for 'zhuoyi', outstanding: the best in the evaluation; 'lianneng' is honest and able. The 'dai' of 'fadai' is a slip for 'feng', salary, so 'fafeng' is a fine of salary. 'Zhishi huanxiang' is retiring and going home. 'Yangqin gejia' is asking leave to support one's parents, and 'gaobing xiuguan' is resigning on grounds of illness. 'Gaodao' is flying far away and living in retirement without office, so 'gaodao zhi huai' is the wish to resign and retire; 'fengchen zhi fu' is being bound by worldly ties, here meaning one cannot get away. The book's judgments: the grand evaluation wants Pressure without flaw and the Self line with force; Output moving and Peer stirring are both unfavourable; broken Pressure means retirement; resigning is the other way round, and Pressure controlling the Self, the Pressure line broken, extinct, Void or scattered, and the Self following into the tomb and helping the injury all mean one cannot resign. Read against the Yi Yin on dismissal and reinstatement (YY.28) and on being in office (YY.20).

units.title: 任乱地求身安与任危邦求爵显：任乱地随墓助伤世穷鬼发非祥；任危邦官隆世实则吉；治河防决忌鬼动鬼克、抽税征商忌应空财坏、考卷有瑕用父母、征徭无用妻财，志此用此志彼用彼

rule.yi: 到乱地去任官而求身平安，随墓、助伤、世穷、鬼发，都不吉祥；到危邦去任官而求爵位显赫，官旺、世实，就吉。例如治河防决口，忌鬼动、鬼克；抽税征商，忌应空、财坏；考卷有瑕疵，用父母；征徭役，不用妻财；占的人志在这件就用这个爻，志在那件就用那个爻。
rule.en: Taking office in a disordered region and seeking personal safety, following into the tomb, helping the injury, the Self at its end and Pressure moving are all inauspicious; taking office in a perilous state and seeking a distinguished title, thriving Pressure and a solid Self are auspicious. For example, in managing a river and guarding against a breach, Pressure moving or controlling is to be avoided; in levying taxes on merchants, a Void Other and damaged Wealth are to be avoided; a flaw in the examination papers uses Resource, and levying labour service does not use Wealth; where the diviner's aim lies, that line is used, and if the aim is elsewhere, the other line is used.

zh: 任乱地而求身安，随墓助伤、世穷鬼发非祥，
任危邦而求爵显，官隆世实则吉。
yi: 到乱地去任官而求身平安，随墓、助伤、世穷、鬼发，都不吉祥；
到危邦去任官而求爵位显赫，官旺、世实，就吉。
en: Taking office in a disordered region and seeking personal safety, following into the tomb, helping the injury, the Self at its end and Pressure moving are all inauspicious;
taking office in a perilous state and seeking a distinguished title, thriving Pressure and a solid Self are auspicious.

zh: 设如治河防决，忌鬼动鬼克，
抽税征商，忌应空财坏。
考卷有瑕用父母，征徭无用妻财，
在占者志此用此，志彼用彼也。
yi: 例如治河防决口，忌鬼动、鬼克；
抽税征商，忌应空、财坏；
考卷有瑕疵，用父母；征徭役，不用妻财；
占的人志在这件就用这个爻，志在那件就用那个爻。
en: For example, in managing a river and guarding against a breach, Pressure moving or controlling is to be avoided;
in levying taxes on merchants, a Void Other and damaged Wealth are to be avoided;
a flaw in the examination papers uses Resource, and levying labour service does not use Wealth;
where the diviner's aim lies, that line is used, and if the aim is elsewhere, the other line is used.

note.yi: 「乱地」是政局混乱的地方，「危邦」是危险的国家。「世穷」按文意是世爻无气、到了尽头。注里的几个例子：治河防决口怕鬼动、鬼克；抽税征商怕应空、财坏；考卷有瑕疵要用父母（父母主文书、考卷）；征徭役不用妻财（徭役出的是人力，不是钱）。总的原则是『占的人志在哪一件，就取哪一个爻』：同一个官职，所问的事不同，用爻也不同。和黄金策仕宦的抚绥百姓（HJC.22）、巡察四方（HJC.23）对着看。
note.en: 'Luandi' is a place where public order has broken down, and 'weibang' is a perilous state. 'Shiqiong', by the sense, is the Self line without force, come to its end. The examples in the note: in managing a river against a breach one fears Pressure moving or controlling; in levying taxes on merchants one fears a Void Other and damaged Wealth; a flaw in the examination papers uses Resource (Resource governs documents and papers); levying labour service does not use Wealth (labour service pays in manpower, not money). The general principle is 'where the diviner's aim lies, that line is taken': for the same office, the line used differs with what is asked. Read against the Huangjin Ce on pacifying the people (HJC.22) and on touring and inspecting the regions (HJC.23).

units.title: 公揭参疏、交代、官来与觅人代署：公揭参疏犹词讼，先占上意从违、次考应爻生克；何时交代以官鬼墓绝、子孙生值为期；何时官来不拘士庶僚役以官鬼生旺为实；觅人代署应空则谁代之，或从官或从人，用爻当晰

rule.yi: 凡是公开揭发、参劾上疏的事，就像词讼一样：先占上面的意思是依从还是违背，再看应爻的生克。问什么时候交代（与继任人交接）：以官鬼入墓、入绝，子孙生旺值日（月）为期。问什么时候新官来：不论是读书人、百姓、官员、衙役，都以官鬼生旺为应验。找人代理署事：应空，谁来代他？或者从官（爵位）看，或者从人（那个人）看，用爻应当分清。
rule.en: A public denunciation or impeaching memorial is like a lawsuit: first divine whether the higher authority will comply or go against it, then examine the generating and controlling of the Other line. When will the handover be: the date is set by Pressure entering the tomb or extinction and Output being born or on duty. When will the new official come: whatever sort of person, scholar, commoner, official or runner, it is confirmed by Pressure being generated and thriving. In seeking someone to act in the post: if the Other is Void, who will stand in for him? Either look from the office (its rank) or from the man, and the line to use should be made clear.

zh: 凡公揭参疏，犹词讼也，先占上意从违，次考应爻生克。
何时交代，官鬼墓绝、子孙生值以为期；
何时官来，毋拘士庶僚役，官鬼生旺以为实。
觅人代署，应空谁为代之，或从官，或从人，用爻当晰也。
yi: 凡是公开揭发、参劾上疏的事，就像词讼一样：先占上面的意思是依从还是违背，再看应爻的生克。
问什么时候交代：以官鬼入墓、入绝，子孙生旺值日为期；
问什么时候新官来：不论是读书人、百姓、官员、衙役，以官鬼生旺为应验。
找人代理署事：应空，谁来代他？或者从官看，或者从人看，用爻应当分清。
en: A public denunciation or impeaching memorial is like a lawsuit: first divine whether the higher authority will comply or go against it, then examine the generating and controlling of the Other line.
When will the handover be: the date is set by Pressure entering the tomb or extinction and Output being born or on duty;
when will the new official come: whatever sort of person, scholar, commoner, official or runner, it is confirmed by Pressure being generated and thriving.
In seeking someone to act in the post: if the Other is Void, who will stand in for him? Either look from the office or from the man, and the line to use should be made clear.

zh: 官来，指其爵也，
人代，指其人也，
用爻微细如此。
yi: 问官来，指的是那个官位的爵；
问人代，指的是那个人；
用爻要细到这个地步。
en: 'The official's coming' refers to the rank of that post;
'someone standing in' refers to that man;
the line to use must be distinguished as finely as this.

note.yi: 「公揭」是公开的揭帖，「参疏」是参劾的奏疏，这一类像打官司（词讼），所以先看上意、再看应爻。「上意从违」是上面的意思是依从还是违背。「交代」是前后任官员交接。「官来」是继任的官什么时候到。「代署」是找人代理（署理）这个官职。「士庶僚役」是读书人、百姓、官员、衙役，不论哪一类人来接任，都以官鬼生旺为应验。书里自注：「官来」问的是那个官位（爵），「人代」问的是那个人，用爻要分得这样细。「交代」的应期取官鬼入墓绝（旧官的运尽）和子孙生旺（新的接替）：这与易隐官禄占的替代（YY.24）用官逢死墓绝日代、子旺动即时可代是同一类。
note.en: 'Gongjie' is a public placard of accusation, and 'canshu' is a memorial of impeachment; this kind of matter is like a lawsuit, so one first looks at the higher authority's mind and then at the Other line. 'Shangyi congwei' is whether the higher authority will comply or go against it. 'Jiaodai' is the handover between the outgoing and incoming officials. 'Guan lai' is when the successor arrives. 'Daishu' is finding someone to act in the post. 'Shishu liaoyi' are scholars, commoners, officials and runners: whichever sort of man comes to take over, it is confirmed by Pressure being generated and thriving. The book's own gloss: 'the official comes' asks about the rank of that post, and 'someone stands in' asks about that man, and the line to use is distinguished this finely. The timing of the handover takes Pressure entering the tomb or extinction (the old official's luck exhausted) and Output being born or thriving (the successor), the same kind as 'Pressure meeting a day of death, tomb or extinction takes over; Output thriving and moving can take over at once' in the Yi Yin on replacement (YY.24).

units.title: 杂职（太医、僧纲、道纪）：所喜惟官旺财备，所戒乃鬼克世空及随墓助伤；凡占杂职皆同此

rule.yi: 太医、僧纲（僧官）、道纪（道官），所喜的只是官旺、财备；所戒的是鬼克世、世空，以及随墓助伤。凡是占杂职，都和这个相同。
rule.en: For court physicians, Buddhist registrars and Daoist registrars, what is welcome is only thriving Pressure and ready Wealth; what is to be guarded against is Pressure controlling the Self, the Self Void, and following into the tomb and helping the injury. All divinations about miscellaneous posts are the same as this.

zh: 太医、僧纲、道纪，
所喜惟官旺财备，
所戒乃鬼克世空，
以及随助也。
yi: 太医、管僧人的僧纲、管道士的道纪，
所喜的只是官旺、财备；
所戒的是鬼克世、世空，
以及随墓助伤。
en: For court physicians, Buddhist registrars and Daoist registrars,
what is welcome is only thriving Pressure and ready Wealth;
what is to be guarded against is Pressure controlling the Self, the Self Void,
and following into the tomb and helping the injury.

zh: 凡占杂职皆同此。
yi: 凡是占杂职，都和这个相同。
en: All divinations about miscellaneous posts are the same as this.

dispute.yi: 这一条以官旺财备为喜，和易林补遗援监纳吏（EL.74）同：僧官、道官、阴阳官、医官宜鬼旺财兴。黄金策仕宦（HJC.27）却以子孙为僧官、道官、医官的用神，父母发动反而有灾悔，王洪绪也这样说。两边取的象不同：易冒、易林补遗按『官职』取象（有官有俸）；黄金策按『行业』取象（僧道医药主子孙）。
dispute.en: This entry takes thriving Pressure and ready Wealth as what is welcome, as does the Yilin Buyi on buying office and entering the clerks (EL.74): Buddhist officials, Daoist officials, officials of yin and yang, and medical officials should have thriving Pressure and rising Wealth. The Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.27) instead takes Output as the Subject of monastic, Daoist and medical officials, and has Resource moving cause disaster and regret, and Wang Hongxu says the same. The two sides take different images: the Yimao and the Yilin Buyi take it by the image of the office (an office with salary); the Huangjin Ce takes it by the image of the trade (monks, Daoists and medicine belong to Output).

note.yi: 「太医」是宫廷、官府的医官，「僧纲」是管理僧众的僧官（僧纲司），「道纪」是管理道士的道官（道纪司）。「杂职」是不入流的小官。「官旺财备」是官爻旺相、财爻齐备（有官有俸）。「随助」是「随墓助伤」的缩写。原文这一句末尾有一个多出来的「）」，这里去掉。书里自注：凡占杂职都按这个。
note.en: 'Taiyi' is a medical officer of the court or a government office, 'senggang' is the Buddhist official who supervises the monks (the Sengguang bureau), and 'daoji' is the Daoist official who supervises the Daoists (the Daoji bureau). 'Zazhi' is a petty post outside the nine ranks. 'Guanwang caibei' is the Pressure line thriving and the Wealth line complete (an office with salary). 'Suizhu' is short for 'following into the tomb and helping the injury'. The original sentence has an extra closing bracket at its end, which is dropped here. The book's own gloss: all divinations about miscellaneous posts follow this.

units.title: 衙门裁革、公议短长与国务行止：裁革止察官爻（官旺则不裁）、公议短长惟求鬼象（鬼破则中止）、国务行止专从五位（兴革损益得君命为行止、五爻克世则不行）

rule.yi: 衙门裁撤革除，只察看官爻；公议的短长，只求鬼象；国家政务行止，专从五位。官旺就不裁；公议将要实行的事，鬼破就中止；兴办、革除、减少、增加，以得到君命才行，五爻克世，就不能行。
rule.en: Whether a government office is abolished, one looks only at the Pressure line; whether public opinion carries or fails, one seeks only the Pressure image; whether a state affair goes ahead or stops, one follows only the fifth place. Thriving Pressure means it is not abolished; of a matter public opinion is about to carry out, broken Pressure stops it; to set up, abolish, reduce or increase anything, it goes ahead only if the sovereign's order is obtained, and if the fifth line controls the Self, it does not go.

zh: 衙门裁革，止察官爻，
公议短长，惟求鬼象，
国务行止，专从五位也。
yi: 衙门裁撤革除，只察看官爻；
公议的短长，只求鬼象；
国家政务的行止，专从五位。
en: Whether a government office is abolished, one looks only at the Pressure line;
whether public opinion carries or fails, one seeks only the Pressure image;
whether a state affair goes ahead or stops, one follows only the fifth place.

zh: 官旺则不裁。
公议将行之事，鬼破则中止。
兴革损益，得君命为行止，五爻克世，则不行也。
yi: 官旺就不裁。
公议将要实行的事，鬼破就中止。
兴办、革除、减少、增加，以得到君命为行止，五爻克世，就不能行。
en: Thriving Pressure means it is not abolished.
Of a matter public opinion is about to carry out, broken Pressure stops it.
To set up, abolish, reduce or increase anything, it goes ahead only if the sovereign's order is obtained, and if the fifth line controls the Self, it does not go.

note.yi: 「裁革」是衙门被裁撤革除，「公议」是公众（朝野）的议论，「国务」是国家政务。「五位」是五爻（君位）。书里自注：官旺则不裁；公议要实行的事，鬼破则中止；兴、革、损、益（兴办、革除、减少、增加）要得到君命才行得通，五爻克世就行不通。这一条是功名章的结尾，从个人的官职转到了衙门和国家的事；和本书国事章（YM.01 起）、易林补遗朝廷国事（EL.01 起）对着看。
note.en: 'Caige' is a government office being cut and abolished, 'gongyi' is the discussion of the public (court and country), and 'guowu' is the business of the state. 'Wuwei' is the fifth line (the sovereign's place). The book's own gloss: thriving Pressure means it is not cut; of a matter public opinion is about to carry out, broken Pressure stops it; to set up, abolish, reduce or increase anything one must obtain the sovereign's order for it to go through, and the fifth line controlling the Self means it does not. This entry is the end of the chapter on fame and office, turning from a person's own post to the affairs of the offices and the state; read against the chapter on affairs of state in this book (from YM.01) and the Yilin Buyi on the affairs of the court (from EL.01).
